description: 경기도_상시교통량(일반국도 시간대별) [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경기도. 이 데이터는 경기도 관내 일반국도에서 측정된 일별 및 시간대별 교통량 정보를 제공하며, 측정일, 호선명, 지점번호, 상·하행 구분, 지역명 및 시간대(00~24시)별 통행량과 전일. Coverage: 경기도. The portal files it under the publisher 경기도. Its tags are 국도교통량, 시간대별교통량, 교통흐름, 교통통계, 일별교통량. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
